overloads.semanticRole: The SAX Get XML node command returns a long integer that indicates the type of SAX event returned while the XML document referenced in document is parsed.

protocolRefs.multiCallChain: SAX event-driven read loop: call SAX Get XML node repeatedly to advance through the parser events for the document; dispatch on the returned event code to the matching accessor -- SAX GET XML ELEMENT for Start/End Element, SAX GET XML ELEMENT VALUE for XML DATA, SAX GET XML CDATA for XML CDATA, SAX GET XML COMMENT for XML Comment, SAX GET XML ENTITY for XML Entity, SAX GET XML PROCESSING INSTRUCTION for XML Processing Instruction, and SAX GET XML DOCUMENT VALUES for XML Start Document.

constraints: The returned Integer is one of the 'XML' theme event constants: XML Start Document=1, XML Comment=2, XML Processing Instruction=3, XML Start Element=4, XML End Element=5, XML DATA=6, XML CDATA=7, XML Entity=8, XML End Document=9.
